name: Azrael's Manuscript: A Strindberg Phantasmagoria
source:
Step into a ghostly theater with August Strindberg. Your decisions will determine the course of his art, his mind, and his soul, as he races against a mysterious rival. 

Inspired by the three pivotal phases of his career: Naturalism, Inferno, and Dream Plays.

[From [url=https://tintwotin.itch.io/azraels-manuscript]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与奥古斯特·斯特林堡一起走进幽灵剧院。当他与神秘对手赛跑时，你的决定将决定他的艺术、思想和灵魂的走向。

受到他职业生涯的三个关键阶段的启发：自然主义、地狱和梦剧。

[来自[url=https://tintwotin.itch.io/azraels-manuscript]Itch.io[/url]]
